about_the_game:
Step into the shoes of the newest senior at Massville High, where everything’s buzzing about a Friday that seems more important than any final exam. And you don’t want to be dateless when the day comes - even if no one quite knows what happens if you are. Meanwhile, the school’s old military airbase foundations hint at something else lurking in the corridors, waiting to be discovered.

“Date Z: Welcome to Massville High” blends a school-life dating-sim adventure with an eerie mystery. Get to know your girl classmates, uncover hidden truths about this former military airbase, and shape your own story by deciding who to trust - and who to love.

Your First Day

• Meet Unpredictable Classmates – From friendly faces to distant loners, each girl carries their own baggage and motivations. How you approach them could change your entire week.

• Unearth a Hidden History – The former airbase is more than a historical footnote. Keep your eyes open for clues about the past - and how it might shape your next days.

• Shape the Story – A passing comment or a bold confession can open up (or slam shut) key opportunities. Every talk is a chance to nudge the plot in a direction only you can control.

• Second Chances – Thanks to a peculiar device, it’s never truly game over. Go back to key points in your timeline, rethink your choices, and see alternative outcomes.

Key Features

• Branching Paths: Every choice you make shapes your future. Will you chase romance or dig deeper into the school’s secrets?

• Unique Characters: Befriend - and possibly date - a cast of classmates with their own personalities and hidden agendas.

• Campus Clues: Peek behind locked doors, piece together cryptic clues, and uncover a larger mystery lurking under the school grounds.

• Multiple Timelines: Revisit key moments with a curious device that lets you see how different choices can change everything.

• Immersive Visuals: Hand-drawn artwork conveys both the warmth of high school life and the eerie undertones beneath Massville High’s façade.

• Expand Your Story: There’s more to discover beyond the first day - dive into thrilling content and meet new faces as your adventure continues.

Start your first day at Massville High and see how your story unfolds. Will you find a date in time, or will the mystery find you first?

short_description: Navigate high school life in this dating sim meets mystery adventure. Date girls, uncover secrets, and prepare for a Friday Date no one fully understands. With whispers of an old virus outbreak and the past creeping into the present, every choice shapes your fate at Massville High.
